answer_freeze: Freeze all attempted U2 main-comparison answers and incomplete statuses with SHA256 before the first Judge request; score_case verifies exact answer-batch membership.

score_order.cases: Exact development manifest order within each arm

failure_policy.host_incomplete: HOST_INCOMPLETE; success unknown; keep planned denominator; no fabricated answer or Judge call
failure_policy.judge_incomplete: JUDGE_UNRESOLVED; success unknown; keep planned denominator; no repeat or prompt repair
failure_policy.normal_wrong_answer: Retain original answer and native labels without changing inputs, rubric, method or order

runtime_gold_boundary: EvaluationCase/gold/rubric exist only in the offline Root scoring process, after all method answers are frozen.
limits: Local same-family Qwen Judge; model-specific self-evaluation bias remains.
Judge JSON-schema transport is the existing pinned Lab adaptation; native rubric and parser are preserved.
U2 development slice from fixed existing public sources; no independent-family or production claim.

comparison_statistics.memsyco_primary: Native per-track pass indicator; 20 planned cases in each of 3 tracks, reported separately
merit_primary: Native episode success with all90 planned episodes
Native dependent success with all36 planned dependent episodes
Full arc success with all18 planned arcs

unit.memsyco: source_group_id from frozen selection, within each track

comparison_statistics.method: Paired cluster percentile bootstrap; sample groups with replacement, preserve all member cases and both method outcomes; compute difference of case-weighted rates within resampled clusters
comparison_statistics.missing: Keep original planned denominators and report unresolved/missing counts with success-rate lower/upper bounds. If either paired arm has any unscored unit for an endpoint, do not emit its bootstrap CI; do not silently discard unresolved cases.
comparison_statistics.inference_limit: Descriptive uncertainty for this chosen source/generator slice; not a population power guarantee, family generalization, multiple-comparison-corrected discovery, or causally isolated module effect.

implementation.rng: Python stdlib random.Random(seed).choices over sorted source-group/arc IDs; reset same seed for each endpoint/method comparison
implementation.checks: Zero-effect, uniform effect, preservation of unresolved denominator, two correlated clusters and linear-quantile arithmetic checked offline; zero model calls

memsyco: native track and declared subtype where available
full input history_utf8_bytes bands <=4096,4097..8192,>8192; no model-output-based length selection
merit: per-arc original public-message count and input byte length alongside results
descriptive_subgroups.policy: Descriptive denominators and outcomes; do not create subgroup significance claims from sparse groups or select favorable bins after results.
